handLayout.title: Hand layout ({{keymode}}K)

defaultSkin.title: Default skin
defaultSkin.description: The skin the Label screen draws with until you pick another one there. Without a choice it follows osu!'s active skin.

sessionNotify.title: Notify when a song ends
sessionNotify.description: When a map you finished joins this session's list waiting for a label, wofella's taskbar entry flashes. No system notification is sent.
